scenarios.title: mixed-separator dot-dot traversal is denied pre-I/O.
an absolute path on another drive is denied pre-I/O.
drive-relative forms are denied pre-I/O.
malformed or unapproved UNC is denied with zero filesystem/network calls.
standard UNC selection accepts only the exact configured server/share/root identity.
extended, device, NT, mixed-slash, and GLOBALROOT namespaces are denied pre-I/O.
ADS and extra-colon forms are denied pre-I/O.
trailing-dot/space aliases in final or intermediate segments are denied pre-I/O.
all frozen DOS device bases and alias forms are denied pre-I/O.
a mixed-case path inside a case-insensitive Windows root resolves to one object identity.
drive and UNC sibling-prefix paths are denied.
duplicate/ambiguous configured aliases are rejected before authority publication.
a real root-internal file symlink to an external file is denied without secret bytes.
a real root-internal junction to an external directory is denied without enumeration/content.
replacement of the configured root identity retires the old authority.
a nested new file under a valid nearest existing parent succeeds one segment at a time.
a new target whose parent is a real junction is denied with no final external artifact.
symlink, junction, and multi-hardlink existing-write destinations are independently denied.
deterministic existing-read swaps never return replacement bytes or invoke parsers/providers.
deterministic new-parent swaps deny before create or verify controlled no-final-residue rollback.
HTTP range reads the validated handle after pathname replacement.
list/read/search/grep independently deny relative and absolute root escape.
download/DOCX/XLSX independently deny escape before fetch/create and enforce extensions.
image analysis denies escape before parser/provider/network invocation.
read-repo/Git entries and Oracle project/managed-store paths are independently governed.
Persona/Skill identifier, linked-file, and identity mismatches are independently denied.
Playbook traversal/link/overwrite/schema/execution variants are independently denied.
Shell/Script/tool-Terminal/HTTP-Terminal CWD and controlled spawn swaps are independently denied.
watcher target/publish/event/revocation variants are independently governed.
every File Viewer route and reveal/range race uses one authority snapshot.
Settings API, disk config, environment/bootstrap, and transactional failure paths are governed.
a capability-authorized absolute target under the exact selected root succeeds.
child attenuation and same-string/different-identity substitution use exact root identity.
every denied leaf has one redacted audit attempt; audit-sink failure is fail-closed and non-recursive.
every fixed positive receipt appears exactly once, passed, and non-skipped.
authored-source inventory/runtime canaries/package inspection show no raw governed sink bypass.
